recent_loops.title: Isolate cold prefill device critical path
recent_loops.hypothesis: After the kept QLI prefill change, cold 32K TTFT has a removable device-side ScatterNdUpdateSk or Compressor cost that can be isolated from HCCL waiting and reduced without changing model numerics.
recent_loops.reason: Captured one real 8096-row long-prefill scatter mapping per rank: all unique, but uniqueness not yet a general invariant. Existing V2 op gave bit-equal output and was 69% slower than SK in 25-call isolated NPU timing; no safe E2E patch or paired TTFT gain. Source SK deterministic sort+SyncAll suggests a direct unique-index path merits a separate build experiment.

recent_loops.title: Direct unique-index DSA scatter feasibility
recent_loops.hypothesis: Long-prefill DSA compressor slot mapping is unique by construction, allowing a single-pass direct scatter to remove SK sort and cross-core sync on a measurable cold TTFT critical path, with a safe fallback for duplicate or invalid cases.
recent_loops.reason: Captured-shape isolated kernel was faster, but actual DSA-CP fast path activated on eight ranks and same-prompt cold TTFT worsened by 70.19ms mean (+2.9642 percent), 0/8 pairs improved, zero prefix hits. No E2E gain.

recent_loops.title: Compressor ratio4 cold prefill critical path
recent_loops.hypothesis: Compressor ratio4 costs material cold prefill critical-path time that a bounded change can reduce without harming correctness or mixed throughput.
recent_loops.reason: mBase256 isolated candidate built, but first comparable exact-shape screen never completed after >8 minutes versus stock ~1.514ms/call; runtime/integration/tiling cause cannot be distinguished. No E2E or correctness evidence; operational gate failed.

recent_loops.title: Warm c12 decode critical path attribution
recent_loops.hypothesis: Saved eight-rank profiler traces can identify a measured and testable service-level arrival or overlap bottleneck; communication elapsed alone is not removable time.
recent_loops.reason: Saved cross-rank timestamps are confounded by stable ~579us rank6 clock offset plus residual ~206us end spread. Communication elapsed is Idle-only, so collective arrival skew cannot be separated from clock/reporting artifacts or translated to a safe high-value change using current evidence.

recent_loops.title: Warm decode DSA-CP metadata builder active-path attribution
recent_loops.hypothesis: A reusable or vectorizable part of eight DSA-CP metadata builders dominates the no-profiler TP0 prepare span and can reduce full-service warm decode latency.
recent_loops.reason: QLI first NPU scalar read accounts for most measured first-builder host time, but the already-tested all-step CPU-max removal passed parity and gave no robust mixed TPS gain (+0.52% within noise, TTFT worse). Metadata op itself is only ~0.4ms/call. No new semantics-safe, high-value decode patch justified; host span is not a removable E2E bound.
